title: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook mobile apps
description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on mobile devices.
